name: First to Floor
tagline: Which item hits the floor first? A physics guessing game for kids 4+.
description: First to Floor is a friendly guess-the-order game for little kids - ages 4 and up. Colorful items rain down from above: a feather, an apple, a hammer, a pumpkin, a dinosaur. Watch carefully during the slow-motion preview, then guess the order they'll hit the floor. Light things float down slowly; heavy things drop like a rock. Nail the whole row and earn three stars. No penalties, no stress, no loud noises - a wrong guess just means fewer stars and the game always moves on.

features.title: Predict the landing order
features.description: Watch the slow-motion preview, then guess which items hit the floor first. Real physics - feathers float, anvils drop.

features.title: 10 themed worlds
features.description: Animals, fruits, vegetables, household, sport, tools, sweets, farm, dinosaurs and construction.

features.title: Freeze & hint skills
features.description: Slow down time or ask for a hint when the items are flying fast - just enough help to keep it fair.

features.title: Picture collection
features.description: Every correctly-guessed item joins your pokedex-style collection - fun to come back and admire what you've gathered.

features.title: Ad-free, kid-safe
features.description: No ads, no logins, no chat, no interrupting purchases. Designed for ages 4+ with big icons for little fingers.

features.title: Game Center & Play Games
features.description: 16 achievements and a high-score leaderboard to share with the family - optional and opt-in.
